verdict.rationale: Shortcut documents creating Stories, its task unit, from templates, and mentions sharing target dates when mapping projects across teams. Nothing in the evidence shows assigning a Story to a teammate or setting a due date on an individual task, so only part of the story is supported. Missing for 10: documented assignment of stories or tasks to teammates as owners, per-task due dates (the evidence shows only project-level target dates), and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can create tasks and assign them to teammates with due dates

citations.quote: Create Stories from a pre-formatted template, saving time and effort on commonly written Stories
Map out projects across teams, track work from people and agents in one place, communicate health status, and share target dates.
